cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For your sister's wedding, should I book us one room or two? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Double bed, then, or shall I ask for twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait for you in the lobby?

mechanism: A confidently organizes a wedding trip but repeatedly offers B practical choices that indirectly test A place in B life.
confusable: Unlike asking for a relationship label, A asks about bed and family seating; borrowed authority yields the arrangements while pretending to manage them.
comparison: Wedding family placement differs from a former personal towel and its continuing place in a home.
seedUse: Use D78-a wedding/room/twins/breakfast and S02-a directing a schedule dependent on B choices.
